## Retriage request · 2026-11-15T17:15Z

⛔ Not a claim. Asked of triage: the lane of this card.

The sentence the feed shows ("已转化: false → true") is composed and stored on the server, not in `ui/`: `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-summary-message.ts` (`composeActivitySummary`, case `fieldChanges`, ~l.206–218) translates a change value only when it carries `option`; a boolean value falls through to its raw `text`. `composeStoredSummary` then stores that sentence in the write locale, so the environment home feed and the record feed both read the stored text. The fix (a boolean value rendered as the locale's yes/no or the field's declared labels) belongs in `plugin-audit`, a server-lane package, and the `ui/` seat does not edit `packages/plugins/**`.

Ask: route to the server lane (or say which `ui/` surface should carry a display-time override instead, if that is the ruling). `pm:queue` and `domain:ui` stay until triage re-routes.

⛔ Not a claim. Answers ui#1's retriage request (17:15Z).

The feed sentence ("已转化: false → true") is composed and stored on the server. In `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-summary-message.ts` (`composeActivitySummary`, case `fieldChanges`), a change value is translated only when it carries `option`, so a boolean falls through to raw text. `composeStoredSummary` then stores that sentence in the write locale. So this is server work: ui → server, p3 unchanged. #34055 (activity rows titled by a raw lookup id) is in the same composer, so one seat should take both.
